items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: And Walter T. T. Rebue used to be on Oysalon and, Oysalon and Boivin, I believe, Carpestore people. Yeah. And them people had that boat in charge.

ctx.x: Well, that's the Young Tuxedo Band until that band. We were, everybody just scattered out, let's see.

Young Tuxedo Band, we went into, well, you could call that, we even went on the boat in 1927 to play the boat, they call it, used to run for the colored, called the Idlewild. Used to live in the podium in the river. Yeah. It was owned by, let me see, some real estate people now. You had that there in the steamer capital in the present, you know, it was called steamer capital that time before the Canal Street. And they used to run this boat from the podium in the river. Oh, yeah. And that was, Tuxedo gave us that…
Yeah, boat run there a good while.
